description.en: Energy profile diagram showing the activation energy (Ea) for an exothermic reaction and the effect of a catalyst.
description.hi: ऊर्जा प्रोफ़ाइल आरेख जो ऊष्माक्षेपी अभिक्रिया के लिए सक्रियण ऊर्जा (Ea) और उत्प्रेरक के प्रभाव को दर्शाता है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Axes -->
  <line x1="60" y1="320" x2="450" y2="320" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- X axis -->
  <line x1="60" y1="320" x2="60" y2="50" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- Y axis -->

  <!-- Axis Labels -->
  <text x="200" y="360" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#4b5563">Reaction Coordinate</text>
  <text x="20" y="220" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#4b5563" transform="rotate(-90 20,220)">Potential Energy</text>

  <!-- Reactants Energy Level -->
  <line x1="50" y1="200" x2="120" y2="200" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="65" y="220" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#1d4ed8">Reactants (R)</text>

  <!-- Products Energy Level -->
  <line x1="380" y1="280" x2="460" y2="280" stroke="#b91c1c" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="385" y="300" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#b91c1c">Products (P)</text>

  <!-- Delta H Indicator -->
  <line x1="360" y1="200" x2="420" y2="200" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
  <path d="M 400 200 L 400 280" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <polygon points="400,280 404,272 396,272" fill="#000" stroke="none" />
  <polygon points="400,200 404,208 396,208" fill="#000" stroke="none" />
  <text x="410" y="245" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#000">ΔH</text>

  <!-- Uncatalyzed Path -->
  <path d="M 120 200 C 180 200, 200 80, 250 80 C 300 80, 320 280, 380 280" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" />
  
  <!-- Catalyzed Path -->
  <path d="M 120 200 C 170 200, 190 140, 250 140 C 310 140, 330 280, 380 280" fill="none" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

  <!-- Activation Energy (Uncatalyzed) -->
  <line x1="120" y1="200" x2="280" y2="200" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
  <line x1="220" y1="80" x2="280" y2="80" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
  <path d="M 260 200 L 260 80" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <polygon points="260,80 256,88 264,88" fill="#000" stroke="none" />
  <polygon points="260,200 256,192 264,192" fill="#000" stroke="none" />
  <text x="265" y="145" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#000">E_a</text>

  <!-- Activation Energy (Catalyzed) -->
  <line x1="220" y1="140" x2="240" y2="140" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
  <path d="M 230 200 L 230 140" fill="none" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="1" />
  <polygon points="230,140 226,148 234,148" fill="#16a34a" stroke="none" />
  <polygon points="230,200 226,192 234,192" fill="#16a34a" stroke="none" />
  <text x="190" y="175" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#16a34a">E_a'</text>

  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="250" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#ef4444" text-anchor="middle">Activated Complex</text>
</svg>
